definition: אָפ֑וּנָה Ps 88:16 ( ἄρ . λεγ Dl Pr 135 f. compare Assyrian appuna(ma) adv. = ma°diš , very, very much , but dubious; Thes MV form from √ פון & compare Arabic diminuit, mente diminuit ( Frey ), hence be confused, helpless , compare ᵐ5 ἐξηπθρήθην ᵑ9 contur-batus sum ; others emend אָפוּגָה from פּוּג q. v. A verb however is not needed for parallelism). ** Arabic in fact = milk (camel, etc.) dry, empty ; = empty-headed man ; this does not support be confused, helpless (GFM, privately).

BDB671 [H6323]

BDB670 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB672

אָפ֑וּנָה Ps 88:16 (ἄρ. λεγ DlPr 135 f. compare Assyrian appuna(ma) adv. = ma°diš, very, very much, but dubious; Thes MV form from √ פון & compare Arabic diminuit, mente diminuit (Frey), hence be confused, helpless, compare ᵐ5 ἐξηπθρήθην ᵑ9 contur-batus sum; others emend אָפוּגָה from פּוּג q. v. A verb however is not needed for parallelism).

**Arabic in fact = milk (camel, etc.) dry, empty; = empty-headed man; this does not support be confused, helpless (GFM, privately).
